title: City Council — September 19, 2023 Work Session, Board of Canvassers and Business Meeting

votes.motion: MOTION: Council Member Bracken moved to ADJOURN the City Council Work Session. The motion was seconded by Council Member Newell

MOTION: Board Member Holton moved to Certify the Results of the 2023 Primary Election. The motion was seconded by Board Member Bracken. Vote on motion: Board Member Holton- Aye, Board Member Bracken-Aye, Council Member Newell-Aye, Council Member Birrell-Aye, Mayor Weichers-Aye
MOTION: Board Member Holton moved to ADJOURN the Board of Canvassers Meeting. The motion was seconded by Board Member Newell

MOTION: Council Member Holton moved to TABLE Consideration of Ordinance 403 - Amending Code Chapter 19.72, Sensitive Lands Evaluation and Development Standards (“SLEDS”). The motion was seconded by Council Member Newell. Mr. Tingey commended Staff for their response to the public as many of the changes have been minor. He emphasized that they have been very transparent in notifying individuals of changes and getting information to those on the email list, as requested. The motion was seconded by Council Member Holton. Vote: Council Member Bracken-Aye, Council Member Newell-Aye, Council Member Holton-Aye, Mayor Weichers-Aye

MOTION: Council Member Holton moved to APPROVE the Minutes of the City Council Work Session, CDRA Meeting, and the City Council Business Meeting of September 5, 2023. The motion was seconded by Council Member Newell
